Release storage.

## Synopsis

```text
release [storage=<storage>] [sd=<sd>] [<storage-name>] [drive=<drive>]
        [device=<device>] [alldrives] [jobid=<jobid>] [job=<job>]
        [ujobid=<ujobid>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Asks the Storage Daemon to release the volume in a device without unmounting the device. On tape drives the tape is rewound; the next job reads the label again and may request another volume. It changes the device state in the Storage Daemon, not the catalog.

The storage is given as storage=, sd= or by its bare name; without it a selection list appears. drive= picks one drive, alldrives releases every drive of the storage. jobid=, job= or ujobid= use the storage of a running job.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `storage=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name. |
| `sd=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name (as storage=). |
| `<storage-name>` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  | positional | Storage name without key. |
| `drive=` | integer |  |  |  | Drive number. |
| `device=` | string |  |  |  | Device name. |
| `alldrives` | keyword |  |  |  | Every drive of the autochanger. |
| `jobid=` | integer |  |  |  | Storage of a job. |
| `job=` | resource | from [`.jobs`](../dot-jobs/) |  |  | Storage of a job. |
| `ujobid=` | string |  |  |  | Storage of a job. |

## Examples

Release the volume of the File storage:

```text
release storage=File
```

Release every drive of the autochanger:

```text
release storage=Autochanger alldrives
```
